description: The sign lists 18 generic Z-Crystals, each at 10,000 with finite stock one. Use +store and Buy items; for example Normalium Z 1. Check +inventory and +itemdex, then equip with +hold <party slot>=<crystal> outside battle. Each crystal accepts only its reviewed active source; +zmove [actor] lists your actual choices. For Normalium Z use +zmove [actor] Tackle=<target>. This queues one move without a second +attack, with one Z use per side per battle and one source PP after prevention. No ring, quest or crystal consumption. Return it with +hold <party slot>= after battle. Other source moves, status and signatures remain deferred. The back exit returns to the selected public hub. No automatic refill or resale.
